email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Social Media Specialist position at Samsonite. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your brand's digital presence across Europe.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. I have hands-on experience with social media integration, content management, and performance tracking using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. My project mirook.com involved creating engaging content and implementing structured data to improve visibility, which aligns with your need for compelling digital storytelling.

I am proficient in Meta, TikTok, and Pinterest, and I am eager to expand my skills in paid social campaigns. My analytical mindset and attention to detail ensure that I can monitor performance metrics and optimize campaigns effectively. I am a team player who thrives in collaborative environments and am quick to adapt to new technologies.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am fluent in English. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Samsonite's social media strategy.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media Specialist position at Samsonite. As a digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, SEO, and social media, I am drawn to Samsonite's legacy of innovation and its global reach. I am eager to bring my skills in crafting engaging content and optimizing digital campaigns to support your brand's storytelling across European markets.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my ability to create compelling content that drives organic traffic. I write keyword-targeted blog posts, manage on-page SEO, and build WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. This experience has taught me to simplify complex ideas into clear, engaging narratives—a skill essential for social media storytelling. Additionally, I have integrated social media channels into client websites, ensuring a cohesive brand presence.

My project mirook.com showcases my initiative and technical expertise. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD) for better search visibility, and created content that resonates with the target audience. I also manage the site's Instagram and Facebook integration, demonstrating my ability to foster community engagement.

I am proficient with analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, which I use to monitor performance and guide content strategy. I am eager to apply these skills to manage and optimize organic and paid campaigns on Meta, TikTok, and Pinterest. My analytical mindset and attention to detail ensure that I can track key metrics such as CPM and CTR to drive results.

I am a proactive learner, always staying updated on digital trends and emerging technologies. I am fluent in English and have a basic knowledge of Dutch, which I am actively improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am ready to collaborate with brand and country marketing teams to amplify campaigns.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background and enthusiasm can contribute to Samsonite's digital success. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
